data.name: Athena Trivia
data.detailed_description:
Athena Trivial is a general trivia game which you can play on your own to enhance your knowledge.

Features:
- 100 uniquely crafted questions which are not taken from public trivia sources
- 10 different categories
- Detailed explanation for each correct answer, to help you enhance your knowledge.
- scoring system based on how quickly you can answer a question.
